about_short_description.short_description: Abdul Latif Jameel Finance provides financial services for car spare parts, car maintenance, and car insurance.

product.name: Car Insurance Financing Program
product.description: A financing service that allows customers to pay for car insurance in installments over a period of up to one year without a down payment.

product.name: Car Maintenance Financing Program
product.description: A financing service enabling customers to pay for car maintenance services in installments up to one year, with no down payment required.

product.name: Car Spare Parts Financing Program
product.description: A financing service that allows customers to purchase car spare parts through installment payments, supporting vehicle reliability and safety.

product.name: Electric Vehicle Financing Program
product.description: A financing program designed to support the purchase of electric vehicles with flexible payment terms and a minimum down payment requirement.

product.name: Jameel Rewards Loyalty Program
product.description: A digital loyalty program offering customers discounts and special benefits through a rewards system.
